svg.title: Toolkit
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript, Python, Java, SQL; Frontend: React, Next.js, React Native, Expo, Tailwind CSS; Backend: Supabase, Postgres, FastAPI, Node.js; Ai: Anthropic API, OpenAI API, agents, structured extraction; Integrations: Plaid, RevenueCat, Shippo, Resend, Twilio, Google Maps; Shipping: Vercel, Docker, Vitest, Playwright, Git.
